verdict.rationale: Anrok is an API-driven sales tax SaaS, so outbound webhooks are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents only request/response REST endpoints (customers, transactions, certificates, filings) and never mentions registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. 'Early alerts' on the pricing page is a related feature, not a webhook a program can receive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
